title: Sampler
description: Plays one sample (a WAV file of the project) on the notes it receives, moved in pitch from a root note. It needs a file and notes, and gives audio.

parameters.name: file
parameters.placeholder: choose a sample of the project
parameters.doc: The WAV file that is played.

parameters.name: root
parameters.doc: The note (60 is middle C) at which the file sounds as recorded; other notes move it up or down.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.doc: oneshot plays the sample to its end; hold cuts it when the note ends.

parameters.name: release
parameters.doc: Fade when a held note ends.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: An audio (WAV) file of the project (parameter file).
